title: Set up the Godot web project
note: Compatibility renderer, folders, autoload stubs and a single-threaded Web export preset. Done when an empty build loads on the private itch.io page in desktop and phone browsers.

title: Card and loadout data format
note: Typed .tres Resources for cards, loadout items, squads and run config, loaded by a CardDB autoload. Done when every field in core-rules §3–5 is covered and bad data fails loudly.

title: Write card, loadout and squad data
note: Author all 26 cards, loadout items, 4 Perks, 4 killstreaks, 3 enemy squads, run config and the tutorial script. Done when values match core-rules or a logged change.

title: Round loop and firefight rules
note: Deterministic, node-free rules engine for Briefing → Score with initiative, line order and all 7 keywords. Done when 40+ headless tests pass, including every edge case in core-rules §9.

title: Streaks, killstreaks and respawn
note: Streak meter, 4 killstreaks, 4 Perks, Sidearm, Frag, Flashbang and Operator respawn. Done when tests prove the streak resets only when your Operator goes down, after that round's eliminations count.

title: Zone Control and Firefight modes
note: Both win conditions with the round-8 cap, overtime and draw rules, driven by data. Done when both modes finish in ≤ 8 rounds in tests.

title: Enemy AI and red-dot intel
note: Rusher and Anchor AI that commits its plan first and never peeks at your cards. Done when red dots match AI deployments 100% and an AI turn takes < 200 ms on a phone.

title: Board and HUD layout
note: Three lanes, minimap red dots, score bar, Supply, READY and Operator panel, built with anchors and containers. Done when it reads well at 1280×720 and on a phone in landscape (844×390).

title: Hand, card inspector and deploying
note: Deploy by drag or tap-card-then-tap-lane; long-press or right-click opens the card inspector. Done when a full round is playable with mouse only and with touch only, nothing hover-only.

title: Run flow (5 matches, 3 tickets)
note: RunState drives 5 matches, tickets, rewards, weapon levels and Perk offers, and survives a browser reload. Done when a run can be won and lost end to end.

title: Run and reward screens
note: Loadout pick, run map, Supply Drop, attachment and Perk choices, After-Action and run end. Done when every choice is one tap and works on a phone.

title: Outcome preview overlay
note: Toggleable per-lane prediction of damage, eliminations and control using the real rules engine. Done when it matches actual results in QA's scripted cases.

title: Placeholder art kit and themes
note: HUD and card themes, OFL fonts, one original icon sheet and flat card frames with friend/enemy shape cues. Done when cards read at 50% scale and nothing resembles a franchise HUD or logo.

title: Combat feedback and streak effects
note: Tracers, hit markers, killfeed, streak arc with shatter, killstreak takeover and XP pop-ups, all Tweens. Done when it holds 60 FPS on desktop and 30+ on a phone, with a fast-animations toggle.

title: Tutorial match
note: Scripted first match teaching deploy, firefight, streak and the Recon Drone call-in; skippable. Done when a new tester finishes it in ≤ 5 minutes.

title: Playtest logger and surveys
note: PlaytestLog autoload records all planned events from EventBus, plus consent, pre-survey and end survey. Done when Download log works in desktop and phone browsers.

title: Loading screen and size budget
note: Loading screen with progress; assets under 5 MB. Done when a cold load measures under 10 s at 20 Mbps and is recorded in qa/performance-logs.

title: QA: rules, devices and release check
note: Rules and edge-case pass, device matrix (desktop browsers, Android Chrome, iOS Safari), mouse-only and touch-only passes, IP name checklist. Done at 0 critical and ≤ 10 minor bugs.

title: Balance pass
note: 10+ logged internal matches per mode; tune toward the target win rates and ≤ 1 unspent Supply. Done when changes are recorded in balance-log.md and run length is 30–45 min.

title: Internal playtest and go/no-go
note: 3–5 internal sessions, KPI sheet from the logs, and a short readout with the tester brief. Done when there is a go/no-go for external playtest round 1.
